reason: I lost two big accounts last quarter and I already have a target country picked, so I need a pipeline there now, not in six months. The free 15-company sample costs me one call, and EUR 1,500 at risk is less than two months of a junior SDR who would still need Apollo, a domain setup and me to train him.
objection: Five meetings is a low bar for manufacturing. I worry they will be with procurement clerks or tiny distributors who take the call and never order, and our sales cycles are long, so 60 days will not tell me if any of it turns into revenue. And a logistics reference does not prove it works for industrial buyers.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are generic or the local-language message reads like a translation, I walk away and do it with Apollo and a hire instead.
